parts.lesson_anchor: lower-level invariant replaces higher-level instruction; both product and workbench controls

deviations: Original routing already covers retry storm via retry and new product need via backlog fallback. This service supplies the complete router, strict owner/numeric schema, stable same-fingerprint accumulation and full action-identity gate correctly, avoiding repeated45/46 and26/33 primary defects.

Explicit product/workbench impacts use separate actions; product feedback shapes outcome-frame/backlog while workbench uses the owning-layer route. Target metadata misbinding, lost second impact and promotion-based review date are newly planted service defects, not claims the original code has those fields.
Calendar review-on=promotion date+days is an exercise policy implementing review/expiry; performance uses6000 ordinary180-day windows with60/90boundary guards, never millennia or date extremes.
CSV is physical reader/writer with newline empty; no splitlines rewriting. It stores every Action revision rather than claiming multiwriter/crash transaction guarantees.

Retirement evidence qualification is supplied correct rather than reimplementing51 claim-to-receipt matching. Exact window endpoints, approval requirement and keep/review/retire ordering are conservative deterministic exercise rules, not proof of real-world safety.

Lineage edges explicitly assert same-impact coverage. The exercise uses transitive suppression even across retired intermediates; graph schema/cycle validation is iterative for general finite DAGs. This avoids odd/even active-ancestor semantics and does not infer replacement from natural language.

The physical CSV read_rows/append_row codec is correct in starter, including newline handling, quoting, integer priority and tuple sources. CRLF/Unicode assertions and codec wrong fixes guard the provided implementation. Candidate Part2 implements the owned-history policy: global revisions, every repeated review observation and exact artifact history across product/workbench controls.
